sloka: शसनात् वा अपि मोक्षात् वा स्तेनः पापात् प्रमुच्यते ।राजा तु अशासन् पापस्य तद् आप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥४-१८-३२॥
transliteration: śasanāt vā api mokṣāt vā stenaḥ pāpāt pramucyate ।rājā tu aśāsan pāpasya tad āpnoti kilbiṣam ॥4-18-32॥

translations.english: 'Men who have perpetrated sins should be subjected to punishment by kings so that they become stainless and attain heaven like pious men who have performed good deeds.
